title: Nonnegative noise mass
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with at least two elements, and let $\rho$ satisfy $-1/(|\Omega|-1)\le \rho\le 1$. For $x,y\in\Omega$, define the nonnegative noise mass to equal $\bigl(1+(|\Omega|-1)\rho\bigr)/|\Omega|$ if $y=x$, and $(1-\rho)/|\Omega|$ otherwise.
